arms.description: Recompute the complete logical prompt online.
Reuse one KV artifact generated from the complete logical prefix. This is an exact full-context cached-prefix control and is intentionally distinct from independently generated per-document segments.

Reuse per-document KV computed independently and stored post-RoPE; the connector reports the document/system prefix as already computed and hydrates it into GPU KV. Correct for single-document (true-prefix) reuse; multi-document quality is limited by missing cross-document attention.
